comparison.objective: Perform a dipstick oil check: pull, wipe, reseat, pull/read, record and reseat; candidate extracts a terminal.
comparison.physical_skill: Repeated long-blade extraction/insertion, rag wiping, fluid-mark reading and recording versus inserting a separate blade under a connector latch while controlling the wire.
comparison.success_condition: Valid wipe/reseat/read sequence, recorded level and dipstick restored; candidate requires terminal removal without bypass or connector damage. Candidate numeric thresholds are missing.
comparison.reason: Although both include a thin tool and pulling, the tested sensing/procedural abilities and final states differ.
